messages.tagline: A little clarity. A next step.
messages.intro: Find public support for a difficult situation. You choose what to explore and what to do next. No account. No need to tell your whole story.
messages.motto: Sakhi handles the complexity. You stay in control.
messages.topics: A starting point for what matters to you
messages.topicIntro: You do not need to name what happened to explore your options.
messages.how: A few steps. Always your choice.
messages.how1body: A few choices, without asking for your identity.
messages.how2body: Official sources, with dates, scope and limits.
messages.how3body: Open a service yourself. Nothing is sent for you.
messages.private: Your words stay in this session
messages.notService: Sakhi is a support navigator, not an emergency response, counselling or legal services provider. It has no government affiliation.
messages.deviceBody: Someone with access to your device, browser history or backups may see your activity. Clearing this session does not erase history, screenshots or external copies. Use a device you trust if that is possible.
messages.translationNotice: Beta translation. Human language and safeguarding review are pending. Service details and safety instructions use English as an explicit fallback.
messages.semantic: Semantic search disabled. Local keyword retrieval is available.
messages.goalQuestion: What would you like to do?
messages.ageQuestion: Is this for someone 18 or older?
messages.situationQuestion: What kind of support are you exploring?
messages.textLabel: A few words, if you want
messages.placeholder: For example: someone made a fake account of me
messages.textHint: Leave out names, phone numbers, addresses and intimate details. Do not upload images.
messages.resultsIntro: These public entry points may help. You can explore more than one, or take no action.
messages.uncertainTitle: We could not identify a specific pathway.
messages.uncertainBody: Here are general official options. You do not need to share more to use them.
messages.minorBody: Adult workflows stop here. Child Helpline and emergency assistance are public alternatives. Please do not share intimate images or personal case details with Sakhi.
messages.emergencyBody: If you are in immediate danger in India, call 112 if you can. Sakhi cannot place a call, dispatch help or check whether a call connects.
messages.shareDone: General help card downloaded. It contains no story or session details.
messages.generalShare: This download contains public resource information only. It creates a file on your device.
messages.leaveTitle: You are in control of this next step
messages.payload: No story or form data will be sent by Sakhi. The external website has its own privacy and account requirements. It may see your IP address and browser information.
messages.deviceCheck: I have considered who can see this device and its browsing history.
messages.demoNotice: Synthetic example. No calls, sharing or external links.
messages.demoDisabled: External actions are disabled in this fictional example. Nothing has been sent.
messages.cleared: Session cleared. Browser history, downloads and external copies may remain.
messages.stale: This source is past its review date. Check the official source for current information.
messages.offline: Offline or API unavailable. Showing the versioned public help pack only. No current service availability is known.
messages.noResults: No current specialized record is available. Use the official general information sources.
messages.correctionBody: Do not include personal stories, identities, intimate media or private contacts. Corrections enter a review queue and never publish automatically.
messages.footer: Built by Kriseva AI. Public sources are independent services, not partners.
messages.friendNote: You can explore public options for a friend without entering her details. Let her choose whether to contact a service. Personalized bystander and safety guidance needs expert review.
messages.offlineBoundary: Public pack only. No live availability, automatic reporting or emergency connectivity guarantee.
messages.privacyTitle: A private starting point, with clear limits
messages.policy: No accounts. No uploads. No tracking. No stored conversations.
messages.correctionDownloaded: A blank public correction template was downloaded. Review it before sharing.
messages.directoryIntro: Only the curated preview pack appears here. Discovery leads are kept separate. Sources were checked by an agent, with human verification still pending.
messages.phoneLimit: Calling opens your device dialler. Connection depends on your carrier and service availability.
messages.sourcePending: Agent source check only. No human signoff or live availability check.
messages.emptyDraft: Private drafts, vaults and provider handoffs are not available in T0.
messages.error: Something could not be loaded. You can still use the emergency number or browse the public pack.
messages.asideCaption: A starting point. Never a decision made for you.
messages.flowStartBody: You do not have to decide whether to report. You can simply understand what support exists.
messages.semanticActive: Local semantic ranking used within the approved pathway.
messages.detaillegal: Understand where to seek legal assistance
